data.name: Ear Cleaning Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Ear Cleaning Simulator

Ear Cleaning Simulator is a relaxing ASMR simulation game where you clean ears using a variety of tools, including ear picks, cotton swabs, fluffy ear cleaners, and ear trimmers.

Remove earwax to earn points, collect gold, and unlock new background music and relaxing items. Enjoy immersive ASMR sound effects and soothing ambient music while creating your own relaxing experience.

Features

  • Relaxing ASMR-focused ear cleaning gameplay

  • Multiple tools, including ear picks, cotton swabs, fluffy cleaners, and ear trimmers

  • Randomly generated jobs with a rank system

  • Unlockable BGM and relaxation items

  • A stress-free Relax Mode for casual play

Streaming and video content are welcome!

Feel free to use the game for ASMR streams, relaxing broadcasts, or other gameplay content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER or AMD Radeon RX 590 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
